replication_role: independent system replication of the Palmer lag-2 performance-linked redistribution result; the lose-switch hinge is a secondary cross-system mechanism contrast because Palmer P3 did not support asymmetry

source.dataset: Population size and breeding success of Adelie penguins on Signy Island from 1978 to 2020
source.provider: NERC EDS UK Polar Data Centre / British Antarctic Survey
source.metadata_fact: nine predetermined Adelie colonies were surveyed annually; occupied/incubating nests, chicks and fledglings are recorded; from 1996/97 onward data conform to CCAMLR CEMP methods

primary_window.rationale: BAS metadata states standard CCAMLR methods were implemented in 1996 and earlier count timing/methods may have varied.

known_from_metadata_mirror: Atomic labels include A2, A3, A4, A41, A62, A63, A64 and later A39.
A1 and A60 appear as a pooled label 'A1 + A60' in later seasons.
Some colonies become extinct/abandoned and some seasons have missing counts.
colony_identity.primary_rule: Treat each literal published colony label as an observational unit. Do not split 'A1 + A60' into A1 and A60 and do not merge any other labels post hoc.
colony_identity.continuity_rule: A unit is eligible for lag analysis only across seasons in which its literal label is unchanged and the required breeding-pair/chick fields are observed.
colony_identity.atomic_sensitivity: Repeat after excluding every non-atomic '+' label. This sensitivity is mandatory if the pooled A1 + A60 label enters the primary panel.

performance_definition.breeding_pairs: Use the dataset's annual breeding-pair measure derived from the nest census under the published Signy protocol.
performance_definition.reproductive_output: Use creched chicks / chicks expected to fledge field only if it is available at the same literal colony-season; do not substitute zero for NA or comments indicating missed surveys.
performance_definition.state: Within each eligible Signy season, compute colony chick output relative to size-proportional expectation and z-standardize the Pearson residual exactly as in Palmer.

primary_replication.endpoint: Palmer-style bias-resistant lag-2 redistribution coefficient beta_2
primary_replication.outcome: Relative log growth of breeding pairs during t+1 -> t+2, centered across eligible Signy colonies in that transition.
primary_replication.inference: Within predictor season, permute reproductive-performance state among eligible literal colony labels, refit complete model, one-sided upper-tail Monte Carlo p.

mechanism_replication.endpoint: P3 lose-switch hinge asymmetry at lag 2
mechanism_replication.inference: Freedman-Lane residual permutation conditional on the linear S effect, within predictor season; same construction as Palmer P3.
mechanism_replication.role: secondary cross-system contrast, not replication of a supported Palmer mechanism
mechanism_replication.palmer_status: Palmer P3 lose-switch asymmetry was not supported (primary delta = -0.0126; one-sided p = 0.5791).

secondary: lag-1 and lag-3 coefficients are descriptive replication-profile endpoints; lag-1 retains denominator-overlap caution if present.
Repeat primary lag-2 and P3 on the atomic-label-only subset excluding labels containing '+'.
Repeat excluding seasons whose published comments indicate nonstandard/late counts or explicit unreliability, using comment flags only—not outcome values—to define the exclusion.

eligibility_gate_before_outcomes.rule: If the metadata/schema audit cannot support these minimums without inspecting fitted effects, classify Signy as infeasible for this replication and do not relax the thresholds.

prohibited: Do not use pre-1996 seasons in the primary analysis.
Do not infer zero chicks/pairs from NA or operational comments.
Do not split pooled colony identifiers using outcome patterns.
Do not change the Palmer lag from 2 after Signy effect estimates are computed.
Do not claim individual breeding dispersal from colony counts.
Do not describe a positive Signy P3 result as replication of the Palmer lose-switch mechanism, because Palmer P3 was not supported.
Do not let the secondary P3 hinge result replace a null lag-2 primary replication.

interpretation.lag2_supported_P3_supported: Independent replication of short-lag performance-linked redistribution plus evidence that Signy, unlike Palmer, also shows the prespecified lose-switch asymmetry.
interpretation.lag2_supported_P3_not_supported: Independent replication of the Palmer-supported dynamic redistribution signal, with the same absence of evidence for a specific lose-switch asymmetry.
interpretation.lag2_not_supported: The Palmer short-lag redistribution signal does not transfer to Signy under the frozen comparable design; P3 cannot rescue a failed primary replication.
